PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: Link your tools to one owned or faction-shared inventory port outside combat.
PluginData.Description:
Lanyard links your tools to one owned or explicitly faction-shared inventory port.
Welder: uses your build planner and normal conveyor access. Grinder: returns ore, ingots and components to the linked inventory. Drill: returns ore to the linked inventory.
Equip a tool, aim at an inventory access port, then type /ly to link.
Open K and select Lanyard, or type /ly menu, for connection controls.
Commands (also available with /lanyard): /ly - link to the targeted inventory port /ly menu - open the standalone panel /ly off - disconnect /ly bounds - toggle the working-area preview /ly bounds off - hide the preview
Use an owned or faction-shared port, stay inside the linked grid's bounds, and work outside combat.
